questions.q: On a Wednesday, a repair estimate for a mantel clock comes to exactly £180. May the assistant approve it on its own?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: On a Saturday, a repair estimate for a wall clock comes to £125. May the assistant approve it on its own, and if not, who must approve it?
questions.gold: No; on Saturdays the own limit is only £120, so Desmond Pryce, the workshop manager, must approve it.

questions.q: A customer asks for a refund of £41, and Desmond Pryce offers to approve it. Who may approve this refund?
questions.gold: Only Miriam Okonkwo-Tull, the owner (Desmond may never approve refunds).

questions.q: Ein registrierter Antiquitätenhändler (Trade-Kunde) möchte an einem Dienstag eine neue Zugfeder (mainspring) für eine antike Taschenuhr; der Kostenvoranschlag beträgt £90. Darf der Assistent ihn selbst genehmigen?
questions.gold: no (mainspring replacements for antique pocket watches always need Desmond's approval)

questions.q: A customer emails that a clock the shop installed has come loose and is hanging over their stairway. What must the assistant do itself, and what two things must it tell the customer?
questions.gold: Call Desmond's emergency line on 07700 900 314 itself; tell the customer a technician is on the way and will arrive within the hour, and that the customer themselves must keep everyone away from the area until the technician arrives.

questions.q: 客户投诉的邮件可以抄送给簿记员 Lena Vasquez-Hart 吗？
questions.gold: no

questions.q: Wird der Posteingang an einem Mittwoch um 10:00 geprüft?
questions.gold: no (10:00 is an extra check only on Saturdays)

questions.q: Is the inbox checked at 11:00 on a Saturday?
questions.gold: no

questions.q: A watch collected 8 months ago comes back with water damage, and the customer asks for a free warranty repair. Is the repair free?
questions.gold: no (water damage is excluded from warranty)

questions.q: With which exact sentence must every email containing an estimate end?
questions.gold: "This estimate is valid for 30 days."
accept: this estimate is valid for 30 days

questions.q: 11月20日购买的回数券，在闭馆期间可以办理延期吗？
questions.gold: yes (ticket books can be extended regardless of purchase date)

questions.q: 11月15日购买的月票可以办理延期吗？
questions.gold: no (only monthly passes bought before November 15 can be extended)

questions.q: A resident bought a monthly pass on November 16, applies for a refund, and also returns a locker key. How much money does the resident get back in total?
questions.gold: 188 yuan (60% of 280 = 168, plus the 20 yuan key deposit)

questions.q: 必须由持票人本人办理吗？一位55岁居民的儿子可以替他办理退款吗？
questions.gold: no

questions.q: May the daughter of a 72-year-old resident submit the extension application on his behalf?
questions.gold: yes (with a copy of the elderly person's ID)

questions.q: Does the December 10 deadline apply to extension applications as well as refund applications?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: 可以在工作日中午12:30到服务中心办理退款吗？
questions.gold: no (processing is paused from 12:00 to 13:00)

questions.q: Who is the contact person for comments or inquiries during the renovation, and what is the phone number?
questions.gold: Zhao Liping (赵立平), 0512-6688 3417

questions.q: Until what date are uncollected items from the lockers kept by the staff?
questions.gold: December 31

questions.q: How much does one book of ticket coupons (回数券) cost, and how many tickets does it contain?
questions.gold: 150 yuan for 10 tickets

questions.q: Ein Kunde möchte dieselbe Kursbuchung zum dritten Mal umbuchen. Darf der Assistent das selbst tun?
questions.gold: no

questions.q: Who must approve a customer's third rebooking of the same course booking?
questions.gold: Needs approval; the approver is not stated.

questions.q: A customer wants a gift voucher worth €76. May the assistant issue it on its own, and if not, who must approve it?
questions.gold: No; Jana Brehmer, the head of the school, must approve it.

questions.q: A group of 10 people wants to rent boats (no course). Who approves this group booking?
questions.gold: Tobias Reuss, the boat keeper.

questions.q: Ein Kunde sagt seinen Kurs 47 Stunden vor Beginn ab und legt eine ärztliche Bescheinigung über seine Krankheit vor. Wie viel wird ihm berechnet?
questions.gold: Nothing; illness with a doctor's certificate is always free.

questions.q: A customer cancels a boat rental 30 hours before the start. How much is charged?
questions.gold: Nothing; boat rentals can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before.

questions.q: An einem Sonntag im Juli möchte ein Vereinsmitglied eine Jolle für 4 Stunden am Stück mieten. Darf der Assistent diese Miete bestätigen?
questions.gold: no (on weekends dinghies are rented for at most 3 hours)

questions.q: A customer emails that their rented boat has capsized. What must the assistant do itself, and what must the customer do themselves?
questions.gold: Call the boat station on 0331 4478 2290 itself; tell the customer the rescue boat is on its way, and that the customer must immediately put on their life jacket and stay with the boat.

questions.q: Wann und an wen wird der wöchentliche Bericht geschickt?
questions.gold: Every Monday at 09:00 to Jana Brehmer.

questions.q: Is the inbox checked at 12:00 in October?
questions.gold: no (the 12:00 check is only from May to September)

questions.q: Untuk sebuah pesanan khusus, pelanggan meminta potongan harga tepat Rp 300.000. Bolehkah asisten memberikannya sendiri?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A workshop participant asks for a rescheduling fee waiver of Rp 120.000. May the assistant waive it on its own, and if not, who must approve?
questions.gold: No; it needs approval, but the approver is not stated.

questions.q: Siapa yang harus menyetujui potongan harga Rp 310.000 untuk pesanan khusus?
questions.gold: Ratna Siregar, the owner.

questions.q: Seorang peserta membatalkan lokakarya 5 hari sebelumnya. Berapa uang yang dikembalikan kepadanya?
questions.gold: Rp 360.000 (fee of 25% = Rp 120.000 deducted from Rp 480.000).

questions.q: Two participants each cancel their workshop exactly 7 days before it starts. How much is refunded to them in total?
questions.gold: Rp 720.000 (each pays a 25% fee of Rp 120.000 and gets Rp 360.000 back).

questions.q: A student with a student card books a workshop for a Wednesday. How much does she pay?
The studio itself cancels a workshop 2 days before it starts. How much is refunded per participant?
questions.gold: The full amount, Rp 480.000.

questions.q: Pelanggan melaporkan bau gas dari kit pembakar mini yang dibeli dari studio. Apa yang harus dilakukan asisten sendiri, dan apa yang harus dilakukan pelanggan sendiri?
questions.gold: Call the studio's emergency technician at 0812-7730-4419 itself; tell the customer the technician will contact them within 30 minutes, and that the customer must immediately close the gas canister valve and open the windows themselves.

questions.q: Who may approve a custom order for 12 pieces?
questions.gold: Only Gilang Prasetyo, the head of production.

questions.q: A hotel places a custom order for 35 pieces with a discount of Rp 200.000. Whose approval is needed?
questions.gold: Both Gilang Prasetyo (more than 10 pieces) and Ratna Siregar (hotel order of more than 30 pieces); the discount itself is within the assistant's limit.
